_comment: B5 build budget (plan-verb-pipeline-and-transport.md § Build cost). Deterministic half (macro_lines_per_verb, total_lines_per_verb) is reproducible for a given toolchain and scripts/build-cost.sh fails the PR on a breach the day it lands, no re-run. Measured half (cold/incr_*_ms_per_verb) is noisy on a shared runner, so it only fails after one re-run over budget. A toolchain bump re-baselines these numbers in the same PR that bumps rust-toolchain.toml — that keeps 'the compiler got slower' separate from 'we generated more'.
rebaseline_2026_10_15: Measured halves re-baselined from CI's own run on a1349182 (four runners sharing one M5 Max; a quiet run measures about half: service 14, core 31). incr_service doubled since 3222f573 because imbib-service grew from 5.8k to 10.2k lines and now holds 164 of 447 verbs in one crate (522k LLVM IR lines, ~40% macro-generated arg plumbing, ~38% serde), and this probe is a non-incremental rebuild divided by ALL verbs. A developer's incremental rebuild of impress-mcp after an imbib-service edit is 3.4-3.7 s. The core probe is crates/impress-core/src/lib.rs since impress-service-core moved to koine (7ff63500).
